FINAL_STATES: u2
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:

(u0, box_fell & !at_exit) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, at_exit) -> u2
(u1, box_fell & !at_exit) -> u1
(u1, holding_box & !box_fell & !at_exit) -> u0
(u1, !holding_box & !box_fell & !at_exit) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, else) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit, u2) -> 1.0
(u1, at_exit, u2) -> 1.0
(u1, holding_box & !box_fell & !at_exit, u0) -> 0.1
feedback: Accepted. Format check passes: REWARD_MACHINE, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION and REWARD_FUNCTION headers are all present and well-formed; FINAL_STATES (u2) is nonempty, declared in STATES, and accepting (absorbing via its else self-loop, with no reward entries in u2, so the exit bonus is paid exactly once). Semantic fidelity: the primary goal 'go to the exit' is the 1.0 on at_exit from both u0 and u1; the secondary instruction is encoded exactly - every box_fell (an event proposition, correctly used as a one-step trigger) opens a one-step window in u1 where holding_box on the next step (equivalent to a successful pickup, since a fall empties the hands) pays the bounded 0.1 progress bonus, and the explicit regression (u1, !holding_box & !box_fell & !at_exit) -> u0 closes the window so a later pickup earns nothing, matching 'very next move'. The machine re-arms on every subsequent fall via u0's box_fell transition, and the u1 self-loop on box_fell & !at_exit safely covers the rare consecutive-fall corner. Irrelevant events: siren_ringing and switch_toggled are never referenced, and every state has an else self-loop (u0->u0, u1->u1, u2->u2), so siren activity and toggles cannot derail progress; ordered guards plus else catch-alls make the machine total and deterministic over all label combinations, and prioritizing at_exit is consistent with the environment constraints that box_fell and switch_toggled never co-occur with at_exit. Reward safety: all rewards are nonnegative and paid only on listed transitions; the 0.1 bonus cannot be farmed (at most two falls per episode, so at most 0.2 extra, u1 is entered only through a real box_fell, and holding_box in u1 can only follow a genuine pickup), so exiting strictly dominates. Reachability: u0 is initial, u1 is reached on any fired fall in box setups, u2 is reached at the exit; in box-less setups u1 is simply unreachable and the machine degenerates gracefully to the exit-only reward, which matches the instruction being vacuous there. Minor non-blocking notes: the !box_fell conjunct in the u1 pickup guard is redundant given the constraint that box_fell and holding_box never hold together; and in the contrived corner where a re-pickup on the step right after a fall coincides with a second fall firing on that same step, the masked pickup (box_fell with hands emptied) earns no bonus for the first fall - unobservable under the label constraints - though the machine stays armed and pays for the second fall's next-step pickup, so incentives remain aligned with immediate pickup.
